## [1.3.0](https://github.com/moeunzinkh-debug/Swiftkey/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0) (2026-09-15)

### ✨ New Features

* **SwiftKey**: reduced to 2 patches only (Disable telemetry, Fix microphone voice input)
* **SimSimi**: 5 patches (Unlock membership, GmsCore Bytecode Redirect, Signature/Availability Bypass, MicroG Account Permissions, GmsCore support umbrella) with recommended versions 9.1.9 and 9.1.8
